intro_payload.title: Plants: Food, Transport & Growth
intro_payload.subtitle: Zero se Railway basics aur advanced plant biology tak
learning_outcomes: Plant ke basic parts aur unke kaam
Photosynthesis aur plant respiration ka farq
Mineral nutrition, nitrogen fixation aur plant hormones
Tropisms, pollination aur seed formation ke basics

learning_path.title: Zero/Foundation
learning_path.description: Plant parts, seedha matlab aur daily-life examples.

learning_path.title: Railway Basic
learning_path.description: Photosynthesis, transport, stomata aur common plant facts.

learning_path.title: Railway Application
learning_path.description: Processes ko examples aur diagrams ke logic se jodo.

learning_path.title: Advanced
learning_path.description: Plant hormones, limiting factors aur linked mechanisms.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plant body ke main visible parts root, stem aur leaves hain. Roots paani/minerals lene aur plant ko mitti mein pakadne mein madad karte hain; stem support aur transport deta hai; leaves food banane ki main jagah hain. Alag plants mein shape badal sakti hai, par kaam ko pehle samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Plant body ke main visible parts root.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Green plants aam taur par autotroph hote hain: wo roshni ki energy use karke apna food banate hain. Animals heterotroph hain, kyunki unhe food doosre organisms se lena padta hai. “Autotroph” ka simple matlab hai self-feeding; plants phir bhi paani aur minerals mitti se lete hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Green plants aam taur par autotroph hote hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Photosynthesis mein green plants light energy ki madad se carbon dioxide aur water se glucose banate hain; oxygen release hoti hai. Saral equation: carbon dioxide + water —light/chlorophyll→ glucose + oxygen. Is process ke liye chlorophyll, light aur raw materials zaroori hain. Railway point: photosynthesis plant ka food-making process hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Photosynthesis mein green plants light energy ki madad se carbon dioxide aur.

quiz_payload.question: Photosynthesis mein plant kaunsa gas release karta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Photosynthesis mein water se bane oxygen ka release hota hai. Carbon dioxide raw material ke roop mein use hoti hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Chloroplast leaf cells mein milne wala organelle hai; isme chlorophyll pigment light absorb karta hai. Chlorophyll green light ko zyada reflect karta hai, isliye leaves green dikhte hain. Advanced link: light reactions thylakoid membranes par aur carbon-fixing reactions chloroplast stroma mein hoti hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Chloroplast leaf cells mein milne wala organelle hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Stomata leaf surface ke chhote pores hain. Guard cells unhe khol-band karte hain. Carbon dioxide andar aa sakti hai; oxygen aur water vapour bahar ja sakte hain. Stomata plant ko gas exchange aur water loss ke beech balance banane dete hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Stomata leaf surface ke chhote pores hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Photosynthesis ki speed light, carbon dioxide, water, temperature aur chlorophyll se prabhavit hoti hai. Kisi ek zaroori factor ki kami process ko limit kar sakti hai—ise limiting factor kehte hain. Bahut high temperature enzymes ko nuksan pahuncha sakta hai, isliye “zyada” hamesha “better” nahi hota.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Photosynthesis ki speed light.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plants bhi respiration karte hain: cells glucose todkar usable energy release karte hain. Respiration din-raat hota hai; photosynthesis ke liye light chahiye. Photosynthesis glucose banata hai, respiration glucose use karta hai. Dono processes ko ek hi cheez mat samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Plants bhi respiration karte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Plant respiration kab hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Living plant cells day and night respiration karte hain. Photosynthesis light ki presence par depend karta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Xylem roots se paani aur dissolved minerals ko plant ke upar ke parts tak le jaata hai. Kai xylem cells mature plant mein dead, hollow tubes ki tarah kaam karte hain. Water movement mein transpiration se bana pull aur water molecules ka cohesion madad karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Xylem roots se paani aur dissolved minerals ko plant ke upar ke parts tak le.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Phloem leaves mein bane sugars ko plant ke un parts tak le jaata hai jahan food chahiye ya store hona hai. Is movement ko translocation kehte hain. Xylem ka main flow paani/minerals hai; phloem ka main cargo sugars. Phloem transport source aur sink ke hisaab se alag directions mein ho sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Phloem leaves mein bane sugars ko plant ke un parts tak le jaata hai jahan.

quiz_payload.question: Leaf se bana sugar plant ke doosre parts tak kaun le jaata hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Phloem organic food, khaaskar sugars, ko source se use/store karne wale parts tak le jaata hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Transpiration plant ke aerial parts, khaaskar leaves ke stomata, se water vapour ka loss hai. Isse water evaporate hota hai, jo xylem mein upar ki taraf pull banane mein madad karta hai. Transpiration cooling mein bhi madad kar sakti hai, par bahut zyada water loss harmful hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Transpiration plant ke aerial parts.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plants ko nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, magnesium jaise minerals chahiye. Nitrogen proteins aur nucleic acids banane mein lagta hai; magnesium chlorophyll ka central atom hai. Roots minerals ko paani mein dissolved ions ke roop mein lete hain. Deficiency se growth aur leaf colour prabhavit ho sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Plants ko nitrogen.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Hawa mein nitrogen gas bahut hai, par adhiktar plants ise seedhe use nahi kar sakte. Soil ke kuch bacteria nitrogen ko usable compounds mein badalte hain. Legume plants ki root nodules mein Rhizobium bacteria nitrogen fixation mein madad karta hai; plant unhe food deta hai, bacteria plant ko nitrogen compounds banane mein sahayata karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Hawa mein nitrogen gas bahut hai.

quiz_payload.question: Legume roots ki nodules mein nitrogen fixation mein kaunsa bacteria madad karta hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Rhizobium legume plants ki root nodules mein rehta hai aur nitrogen fixation mein madad karta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plant hormones chhoti matra mein growth aur response control karte hain. Auxin cell elongation/tropism mein; gibberellin stem growth aur seed germination mein; cytokinin cell division mein; abscisic acid stress/dormancy mein; ethylene fruit ripening mein role karta hai. Ye effects plant, tissue aur condition par depend kar sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Plant hormones chhoti matra mein growth aur response control karte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Tropism growth direction ka stimulus ke response mein badalna hai. Shoot light ki taraf grow kare to positive phototropism; root gravity ki direction mein grow kare to positive geotropism. Tendril support ke around lapet sakta hai—touch response ka example. Plant move nahi karta jaise animal, par uska growth direction badal sakta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Tropism growth direction ka stimulus ke response mein badalna hai.

quiz_payload.question: Fruit ripening se sabse zyada juda plant hormone kaunsa hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Ethylene ek gaseous plant hormone hai jo fruit ripening ko promote kar sakta hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Flowering plants mein pollination pollen ka anther se stigma tak transfer hai; ye fertilization nahi hota. Fertilization mein male aur female gametes fuse karte hain. Fertilization ke baad ovule seed aur ovary aam taur par fruit ban sakti hai. Wind, insects aur animals pollen transfer mein madad karte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Flowering plants mein pollination pollen ka anther se stigma tak transfer hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Plants ke structures environment ke anukul ho sakte hain. Cactus ke spines water loss kam karte hain, fleshy stem paani store karta hai; aquatic plants mein air spaces buoyancy de sakte hain. Adaptation ek inherited feature hai jo survival/reproduction mein help kar sakta hai—har individual apni zaroorat se naya inherited trait nahi banata.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achha Sir, Plants ke structures environment ke anukul ho sakte hain.

quiz_payload.question: Kaunsa statement sahi hai?

options.text: Xylem paani/minerals aur phloem sugars le jaata hai
Photosynthesis sirf roots mein hota hai
Plant respiration sirf raat mein hota hai
Pollination aur fertilization ek hi event hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Xylem water/minerals ka main transport karta hai; phloem sugars ka. Photosynthesis mainly green tissues mein hota hai, respiration day/night hota hai, pollination fertilization se pehle ka alag step hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 1: Ek indoor plant ko kai din andhere mein rakha gaya. Nayi leaf mein starch test kam positive ho sakta hai. Kyon?

options.text: Light na milne se photosynthesis kam hua
Roots ne oxygen ko starch bana diya
Plant ne chlorophyll ko blood mein bheja
Stomata ne soil banana shuru kiya

quiz_payload.explanation: Light photosynthesis ka energy source hai; lambi darkness mein naya sugar/starch banana kam ho sakta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 2: Plant ko paani mil raha hai, par stem ke xylem vessels damage ho gaye. Leaves par kya asar aa sakta hai?

options.text: Paani upar pahunchna mushkil aur leaves wilt ho sakti hain
Sugar phloem se seedha paani ban jayegi

quiz_payload.explanation: Xylem roots se paani/minerals upar le jaata hai; transport rukne par leaves ko paani kam mil sakta hai.

quiz_payload.question: Applied case 3: Khidki ki taraf se roshni aane par potted plant dheere-dheere us taraf jhukta hai. Is response ka naam kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Shoot roshni ki taraf grow kare to positive phototropism kehte hain.
